The entire process is handled through the EleBank mobile app, eliminating the need to visit a physical branch. After completing the application, customers gain immediate access to EleBank's comprehensive banking services, including transfers, deposits, loans, and foreign currency exchange.

Customers can maintain their accounts without worrying about falling below minimum balance thresholds or incurring monthly maintenance charges. As part of EleBank's commitment to accessible banking services, this feature helps customers maximize their savings without the burden of unnecessary fees.

The loan application process is fully digital, with funds potentially available in as little as 5 minutes from application to disbursement. Loan repayment periods range from 6 to 60 months, allowing customers flexibility in managing their finances. The entire application and approval process can be completed through the EleBank mobile app.

promotions.description: EleBank provides multi-currency deposit accounts with no minimum balance requirements. The service is accessible 24/7 through the EleBank mobile app, allowing customers to manage their multi-currency accounts anytime and anywhere.

promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank allows customers to subscribe to money market funds with a minimum amount as low as USD 20. This low entry barrier makes fund investment accessible to more customers regardless of their investment capital.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Global Wallet Competitive Exchange Rates
promotions.highlight: 💱 Get the best foreign exchange rates in town for your global transactions
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers the best foreign exchange rates in town through its WeLab Global Wallet service. The bank conducted a comparison of exchange rates from 28 retail banks in Hong Kong as of January 14, 2026, and confirmed their rates were the lowest. This allows customers to save on currency conversion costs when conducting international transactions. The comparison excluded any special promotions or preferential rates but included all fees charged by banks when conducting FX transactions to ensure a fair comparison. The Global Wallet service helps customers manage multi-currency needs effectively.

promotions.title: WeLab Featured Funds - $0 Subscription and Switching Fees
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Unlimited $0 subscription fee and $0 switching fee for all fund transactions
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a $0 Fund Trading Fee Mode for all customers, featuring unlimited $0 subscription fees and $0 switching fees instead of charging per-transaction fees like traditional banks. This allows customers to make fund transactions without worrying about high front-end load fees. Instead of per-transaction charges, WeLab Bank charges a monthly platform fee of 0.1% based on total fund holdings (excluding money market funds). This fee structure can help customers save up to 85% on transaction costs compared to traditional bank fund platforms that charge subscription fees.
promotions.cost: Monthly platform fee of 0.1% on total fund holdings

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Personal Loan 'R-Friend Referral' Campaign
promotions.highlight: 🤝 Earn HKD 800 for each successful loan referral, up to HKD 8,000
promotions.description: WeLab Bank customers can earn HKD 800 each time they refer a friend or relative who successfully applies for and draws down a WeLab Bank Personal Loan using their designated referral code (with 'FP' or 'TR' prefix). Both new and existing WeLab Bank customers can be referred. The referee must draw down the loan within 7 days after approval. Each customer can earn up to HKD 8,000 in total (maximum 10 successful referrals) during the campaign period. The referral rewards will be credited to the referrer's HKD Core Account on or before 31 July 2026.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Personal Loan Cash Rebate up to HKD 23,888
promotions.highlight: 💸 Earn up to HKD 23,888 cash rebate on approved personal loans
promotions.description: WeLab Bank is offering a cash rebate of up to HKD 23,888 for customers who successfully apply for a WeLab Bank Personal Loan. To qualify, customers must be approved for a loan amount of at least HKD 150,001 with a tenor of 24 months or more, and must draw down the loan within 7 days after approval. The cash rebate will be credited directly to the customer's HKD Core Account on or before 31 October 2026. This offer applies to both Personal Instalment Loans and Debt Consolidation Loans.
promotions.cost: Minimum loan amount of HKD 150,001 with 24-month tenor

promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 1,500 cash reward with eligible fund investments
promotions.description: The 'April Investment GO! Cash Reward' program offers customers a cash reward for making eligible fund investments. Participants need to maintain a Core Account opened before 31 March 2026 and subscribe to any fund with an investment amount of at least HKD 20,000, with an aggregate amount not less than HKD 100,000 by 21 April 2026. Customers must continue holding all fund units until 31 May 2026, and their Current Wealth must increase by at least HKD 100,000 between 9 April and 31 May 2026. The cash reward can be up to HKD 1,500, which equals approximately 4.87% one-month annual rate, and will be credited by 30 June 2026.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Digital Wealth Advisory Service
promotions.highlight: 🤖 AI-powered personalized investment portfolio management
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's GoWealth Digital Wealth Advisory is a permanent service that offers personalized investment portfolio recommendations using AI technology in partnership with Allianz Global Investors. Customers can set investment goals including investment period and contribution amounts, and the system provides tailored portfolio recommendations. After accepting the recommendation, the system will make the initial investment and continue with automated monthly investments based on the customer's settings. The service provides ongoing notifications about investment progress and allows customers to monitor and adjust their goals as needed. This is not a discretionary asset management service, and the recommendations do not guarantee investment outcomes.
promotions.cost: 0.1% monthly platform fee on fund holdings

promotions.title: Investment Fund Cash Rewards - Up to HKD 4,000
promotions.highlight: 💰 Invest and earn up to HKD 1,500 cash reward

Customers need to have opened a valid Core Account before March 31, 2026, maintain their Investment Account, and subscribe to funds with a minimum aggregate investment amount of HKD 100,000 by April 21, 2026. All fund units must be held until May 31, 2026, and the investment account value must increase by at least HKD 100,000 between April 9 and May 31, 2026. The cash reward will be credited to the customer's Core Account by June 30, 2026.

promotions.title: WeLab Money Plus Investment Service
promotions.highlight: 💹 Past one-year return of up to 4.4% with money market fund
promotions.description: WeLab Money Plus is a money market fund available through WeLab Bank's Featured Fund Services, providing returns similar to time deposits without locking in your money. This investment option offers same-day settlement for instructions submitted before the cutoff time (9 AM Hong Kong time). The past one-year performance showed a return of up to 4.4%, with a total return of 10.48% since its establishment on November 22, 2023 (as of March 31, 2026). The service is available to all WeLab Bank customers with an investment account and requires a minimum investment amount of as low as HKD 100.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Tesla Unsecured Loan Referral Reward
promotions.highlight: 🚗 Earn HKD 800 for referring friends to Tesla Unsecured Loan
promotions.description: WeLab Bank customers can earn HKD 800 cash reward for each successful referral of a friend who applies for and draws down a Tesla Unsecured Loan. This referral program runs alongside the Personal Loan referral campaign and follows the same process where customers use their unique referral code to track referrals. The referee must complete the loan application and drawdown within the specified timeframe to qualify. This offer is part of WeLab Bank's partnership with Tesla to provide financing options. The cash reward will be credited to the referrer's account by the end of the campaign period.

Until July 31, 2026, retail banking users who have activated investment fund trading services with ZA Bank can enjoy 0% fund subscription fees on all funds, with no cap on investment amount. This means 100% of your money goes directly into the market, maximizing your investment potential. Additionally, investors can enjoy redemption fee waivers for all funds. This offer provides substantial savings compared to traditional fund platforms that typically charge subscription fees ranging from 1-5% of the investment amount.
promotions.quota: Available to all retail banking users with activated fund trading services

promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers can enjoy an exceptional 20% p.a. interest rate on HKD time deposits through this special promotion. If you also hold deposits, funds, and stocks within 14 days of account opening, you can claim another +19.9% p.a. coupon applicable to deposits of up to HKD 100,000, allowing you to maximize your interest earnings on two separate deposits.

This offers a unique way to build your investment portfolio through daily spending.

promotions.title: Year-Round Travel Offers with ZA Card
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Exclusive discounts and perks for travelers year-round
promotions.description: Enjoy exclusive travel benefits and discounts throughout the year with ZA Bank's Year-Round Travel Offers. As a ZA Bank customer, you have access to special rates and promotions on flights, hotels, and travel-related services whenever you travel. These ongoing offers are designed to enhance your travel experience while helping you save on expenses. The Year-Round Travel Offers program ensures that you always have access to valuable travel perks regardless of when you plan your trips, making ZA Bank a great companion for frequent travelers.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

This promotion has no cap on the number or value of transactions, allowing new crypto investors to trade freely without worrying about platform fees during their initial trading period. Terms and conditions apply to this promotion.
promotions.quota: First-time crypto trading service activations only

promotions.title: Customer Referral Rewards Program for Account Opening
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 90,000 by referring friends to open accounts
promotions.description: Earn substantial rewards by referring friends to open accounts with ZA Bank through the Refer a Friend Account Opening Reward Campaign. The promotion runs from March 26 to May 27, 2026, and consists of 9 phases. During each phase, the top 20 referrers with the most successful referrals can earn up to HKD 10,000 in cash rewards. Additionally, for each successful referral who deposits at least HKD 1,000 within 14 days of opening an account, you'll receive a corresponding cash reward. If your referred friend holds deposits, funds, and stocks within 14 days of account opening, you can earn even more rewards, up to a total of HKD 10,000 for multiple successful referrals.
promotions.quota: Top 20 referrers per phase for ranking rewards

This feature allows you to quickly know if you qualify for the program, helping you plan your debt consolidation strategy more efficiently. While the preliminary approval is provided rapidly, you'll still need to submit relevant documents for final approval. For existing ZA Bank customers, the process is even faster, with preliminary approval results available in as little as 30 seconds after logging into the ZA Bank App.

This limited-time offer provides coffee lovers with an excellent opportunity to boost their stock portfolios.

This ultra-fast account opening feature exemplifies ZA Bank's commitment to making banking more accessible and convenient.

promotions.description: Participate in PowerDraw when you spend with your ZA Card for a chance to win up to a 200% rebate on your purchases. This promotion allows cardholders to earn rewards on their spending through a special drawing mechanism. Every eligible transaction gives you an entry into the PowerDraw, where you can win various rebate percentages on your spending. The PowerDraw system offers an exciting gamified approach to card rewards, making everyday spending more rewarding and engaging. Terms and conditions apply to this promotion.

promotions.title: ZA Card Statement Instalment Program Long Repayment Period
promotions.highlight: ⏳ Extended repayment periods up to 72 months
promotions.description: Manage your credit card debt with greater flexibility through ZA Bank's extended repayment periods. The Credit Card Statement Instalment Program offers repayment terms of up to 72 months (6 years), allowing you to spread out your payments over a longer period for smaller monthly installments. This feature is designed with your loan needs in mind, making debt repayment more comfortable and sustainable for your budget. The longer repayment window can significantly reduce monthly payment amounts, though total interest paid may be higher over the extended term. This option is particularly valuable for those consolidating larger credit card debts who prefer smaller, more manageable monthly payments.

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Savings Account with 11 Currencies
promotions.highlight: 💱 Hold and exchange between 11 different currencies with no fees
promotions.description: ZA Bank's Multi-Currency Savings Account allows users to hold 11 different currencies in a single account, including HKD, CNY, USD, GBP, SGD, EUR, CAD, AUD, JPY, NZD, and CHF. This feature enables flexible asset allocation, allowing customers to exchange currencies 24x7 at their preferred rates to seize market opportunities and grow their wealth. Users can make deposits and withdrawals anytime with zero fees, and enjoy free cash withdrawals throughout Hong Kong at over 3,000 Visa ATMs with their ZA Card. The service is available to all ZA Bank account holders with no additional activation required.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: Custom Card Number Selection for ZA Card
promotions.highlight: 🔢 Choose the last 6 digits on your ZA Card face
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a unique customization feature allowing customers to choose the last 6 digits displayed on their ZA Card face. This is a first-of-its-kind service in Hong Kong, giving users a personal touch to their banking experience. The ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual fees or hidden charges, and it supports both Apple Pay and Google Pay for contactless payments. This personalization option is available to all new ZA Card applicants as part of the standard card issuance process. Customers simply select their preferred digits during the card application process.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Card applicants

promotions.title: Free Instant FPS Transfers and Payments
promotions.highlight: 💸 Send money instantly with zero fees via FPS
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers free instant transfers through the Faster Payment System (FPS), allowing users to send and receive HKD and CNY with just a mobile phone number. The service includes free card payments, tax payments, and scan-to-pay functionality, all integrated within the ZA Bank app. Users can conveniently access frequent payees from the Transfer page for quick transactions. The feature also includes a Group Lai See function, enabling users to send digital red packets to multiple recipients with one tap, eliminating the need to enter recipients individually. This service is available to all ZA Bank account holders at no additional cost.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank HKD 1,000 Spending Rebate Promotion
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Enjoy exclusive travel discounts and offers all year round
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides year-round travel offers for their customers when using ZA Card. These travel benefits include special discounts, promotions, and exclusive deals on flights, hotels, and travel-related services throughout the year. The year-round travel offers are available to all ZA Bank customers who hold a ZA Card, making it convenient to enjoy travel benefits whenever you plan your trips. No special registration is required to access these benefits - simply use your ZA Card for travel-related purchases to enjoy the offers automatically.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Card holders
promotions.cost: Free, requires ZA Card usage for travel-related purchases

promotions.title: ZA Bank Group Lai See Feature
promotions.highlight: 🧧 Send digital red packets to multiple recipients with one tap
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a convenient Group Lai See feature that allows users to send digital red packets to multiple recipients with just one tap. This eliminates the need to enter recipients individually, saving time and effort during festive seasons or special occasions. The service is integrated with the FPS transfer system, enabling instant delivery of funds to recipients using just their mobile phone numbers. Group Lai See is available to all ZA Bank account holders at no additional cost. Users can access this feature directly from the ZA Bank app's transfer section, making it simple to distribute monetary gifts to friends and family.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Digital Insurance - Application in as Fast as 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: ⚕️ Get insured in as fast as 3 minutes via your smartphone
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a quick and simple insurance application process that can be completed in as little as 3 minutes through your smartphone. The service provides comprehensive coverage options including life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS), among others. The fully digital process allows users to apply for insurance plans and file claims easily without paperwork or in-person visits. This service is available to all eligible ZA Bank users who meet the specific requirements for each insurance product. Applications can be submitted directly through the ZA Bank app.

promotions.title: ZA Payment Connect: Zero-Fee Cross-Border Transfers Between Hong Kong and Chinese Mainland
promotions.highlight: 🌍 Send money worldwide with zero ZA Bank fees
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers global transfer services to over 140 countries and regions through multiple channels. The service includes Payment Connect for real-time, zero-fee transfers between Chinese Mainland and Hong Kong, Wise integration for express HKD remittances that arrive faster than traditional methods, and SWIFT transfers directly to 140+ countries and regions with zero ZA Bank fees. These global transfer options are available to all ZA Bank account holders. Users can initiate transfers through the ZA Bank app, selecting their preferred method based on destination, speed requirements, and cost considerations.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers
promotions.cost: Free from ZA Bank side; correspondent banks may charge fees

promotions.title: ZA Card Statement Instalment Plan with Cash Reward up to HKD 2,000
promotions.highlight: 💰 Get up to HKD 2,000 cash reward when clearing your credit card balances
promotions.description: Apply for ZA Card Statement Instalment Program and enter promo code [SURPRISE] to receive cash rewards of up to HKD 2,000. This offer is available for both new and existing customers who successfully apply and complete the cooling-off period of 7 days. The reward amount varies based on the loan amount: HKD 588 for loans between HKD 200,000-399,999, HKD 688 for loans between HKD 400,000-799,999, and HKD 2,000 for loans of HKD 800,000 or above with a repayment period of 18 months or more. The promotion code must be entered during the loan application process and is valid for 14 days after entry.
promotions.quota: No quota mentioned, available to all eligible applicants
promotions.cost: Minimum loan amount of HKD 200,000 required for rewards

promotions.title: Free Cash Withdrawals at 3,000+ Visa ATMs in Hong Kong
promotions.highlight: 💵 Withdraw cash for free at over 3,000 Visa ATMs across Hong Kong
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers free cash withdrawals at over 3,000 Visa ATMs across Hong Kong with the ZA Card. This service is available to all ZA Card holders at any time, providing convenient access to cash throughout Hong Kong without incurring any withdrawal fees. The free withdrawal service is part of ZA Bank's commitment to providing convenient banking services. Overseas cash withdrawals may still incur handling fees, but local withdrawals are completely free of charge.

promotions.title: Stock Trading with Zero Brokerage and Custody Fees
promotions.highlight: 📊 Trade stocks with 0 brokerage, 0 custody fees, and low platform fees
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers stock trading with zero brokerage fees and zero custody fees for all customers. Platform fees are as low as USD 1.99 for US stocks and HKD 18 per transaction for Hong Kong stocks. Customers can also participate in the StockBack program, which allows them to earn free stocks after successfully purchasing stocks through the platform. The service provides a cost-effective way to trade stocks directly from the ZA Bank app, making it accessible to both beginner and experienced investors. Users need to have an active investment account with stock trading services enabled to access these benefits.
promotions.cost: Platform fees as low as USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.highlight: 💳 Win a StockBack x ZA Card metal card worth HKD 1,000
promotions.description: The StockBack Leaderboard promotion runs in three phases during ZA Bank's 6th Anniversary campaign. Participants earn StockBack points by completing designated ZA Quest tasks, using ZA Card with the StockBack reward plan, and receiving designated stock exchange coupons through the 'stock lucky draw'. The top 1,000 participants with the highest accumulated points in each phase receive rewards: the top 60 receive a StockBack x ZA Card metal card (valued at HKD 1,000), while places 61-1,000 receive priority access to the StockBack x ZA Card physical card experience. Each participant can receive the leaderboard reward only once during the entire promotion period. The metal card is an exclusive premium offering not available through standard channels.

promotions.title: Zero-Fee Visa Debit Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay, providing a truly free banking card option for all users.

promotions.title: PowerDraw Up to 200% Rebate + Million Dollar Prize Pool
promotions.highlight: 💰 Win up to 200% rebate and share HKD 1 million prize pool
promotions.description: ZA Card users can participate in PowerDraw to win up to 200% rebate on purchases. Additionally, customers receive MillionTix through PowerDraw for a chance to share in a prize pool of HKD 1 million. This promotion encourages spending with ZA Card to maximize chances of winning substantial cashback and prizes.
promotions.cost: Must use ZA Card for eligible transactions

promotions.title: New Customer HKD 2,026 Reward Package and 2.5% StockBack
promotions.highlight: 💰 New customers earn 2.5% stock rewards on first HKD 10,000 spending
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers can enjoy enhanced 2.5% StockBack rewards on their first HKD 10,000 of eligible spending within 30 days of account opening. This combines the standard 1.5% stock rebate with an additional 1% bonus for new users. Customers must select the StockBack x ZA Card reward plan to qualify for this elevated stock reward rate on initial card spending.
promotions.quota: New users who have never held any ZA Bank products or services
promotions.cost: Must use ZA Card and select StockBack reward plan

promotions.title: ZA Bank HKD 20% p.a. 7-Day Time Deposit for New Referred Customers
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enjoy 20% p.a. interest on 7-day HKD time deposits
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers referred by existing users can receive two 19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest boost coupons (plus base rate for total 20% p.a.). The first coupon is awarded when depositing ≥ HKD 1,000 within 14 days of account opening, valid for deposits up to HKD 20,000. A second coupon is granted when maintaining HKD 1,000 balance across deposits, funds and stocks, valid for deposits up to HKD 100,000.
promotions.quota: New customers who open accounts with referral codes during the promotion period
promotions.cost: Must deposit ≥ HKD 1,000 for first coupon; must maintain combined balance of HKD 1,000 across deposits, funds and stocks for second coupon

promotions.title: ZA Card StockBack 6th Anniversary 6% Cashback on Coffee
promotions.highlight: ☕ Get 6% stock rebates at all coffee merchants
promotions.description: During ZA Bank's 6th anniversary celebration, customers could earn 6% StockBack rewards when spending at any local coffee merchant using their ZA Card. Qualifying transactions needed to be at least HKD 10 and made directly with the card (not through Alipay or WeChat Pay). The reward cap for special coffee merchant rebates was HKD 50 per user during the promotion period.
promotions.quota: All ZA Card holders; maximum combined special rebates capped at HKD 50 per user
promotions.cost: Minimum spending of HKD 10 per transaction required

promotions.title: ZA Bank 24x7 Customer Service
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Round-the-clock customer support every day
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides 24/7 customer service for all users, ensuring assistance is available at any time of day. This always-on support system allows customers to resolve issues, ask questions, and receive guidance regardless of time constraints. The service is part of ZA Bank's commitment to convenient digital banking that overcomes traditional banking limitations.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank Refer to Take Out a Loan Program
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 900 for referring friends to ZA Bank loans
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can earn rewards up to HKD 900 by referring friends to apply for loans with ZA Bank. The referral program provides cash incentives when referred friends successfully obtain loan products. Reward amounts vary based on the loan type and amount approved for the referred friend.
promotions.quota: Available to all existing ZA Bank customers
promotions.cost: Free to participate; referred friends must complete loan application and approval process

promotions.title: Wise Express Remittance Service
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Fast international transfers powered by Wise
promotions.description: ZA Bank has partnered with Wise to offer express remittance services for HKD payments, providing faster international transfers than traditional methods. This service enables customers to send money internationally with competitive exchange rates and transparent fee structures. It complements ZA Bank's suite of global transfer options, including SWIFT transfers to over 140 countries.
promotions.cost: Fees vary by destination and amount
